DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 模型のどの部分が気になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which part of the model interests you?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもが橋のところを何度も見ています。人が通る向きを知りたいそうですが、うまく質問できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子どもが模型の橋の通行方向を知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child keeps looking at the bridge. They want to know which way people go across it, but they're having trouble asking.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your child wants to know the direction of travel across the model's bridge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この模型では、入口からの道を指で追って説明できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: With this model, I can explain by tracing the path from the entrance with my finger.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。子どもの目の高さからだと橋の向こうが見えないので、反対側へ回って見てもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 見えやすい反対側へ回る許可を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. At my child's eye level, they can't see beyond the bridge. May we go around to look from the opposite side?
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask permission to move to the opposite side where the view is clearer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 回ってご覧ください。人が来たら少し場所を譲ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please go around. If other people come, make a little room for them.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。子どもと二人で反対側へ移ります。私は入口を指して、子どもには橋を探してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入口を指し子どもに橋を探させると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. My child and I will move to the opposite side. I'll point to the entrance and have my child find the bridge.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you will point to the entrance and have your child find the bridge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 入口と橋が見つかったら、こちらの道につながります。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once you've found the entrance and bridge, they connect to this path.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: つながりが見えたそうです。帰ってから描きたいので、道の順番を短くメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 道のつながりを理解し順番をメモすると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: My child says they can see the connection now. We'd like to draw it after going home, so I'll briefly note the order of the path.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that the path connections are understood and you will note the order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 模型を写す際は、周りの方にもご配慮ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: When recording the model, please be considerate of the people around you too.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は写真よりメモにします。入口、橋、その先の道と書き、子どもが見つけた順に家で一緒に描きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 見つけた順を家で子どもと描くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take notes rather than photos today. I'll write entrance, bridge, then the path beyond, and we'll draw it together at home in the order my child found them.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will draw it with your child at home in the order they discovered it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご覧いただきありがとうございました。お子さんの絵が楽しみですね。どうぞ残りの見学もお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for looking. It will be exciting to see your child's drawing. Please enjoy the rest of your visit too.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お守りのひもについて、ご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the cord on your amulet?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。鞄から外したら、ひもの結び目が緩んでいました。こちらで見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: お守りのひも結び目が緩んだと確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. When I took it off my bag, the knot in the cord was loose. Could you take a look here?
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a check because the amulet cord's knot is loose. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ひもの状態を拝見します。袋の部分は外れていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll look at the cord. Is the pouch still attached?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 袋は付いたままです。結び目を強く引いたら余計にほどけそうなので、そのまま持って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋は付いたままで引かず持参したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The pouch is still attached. I thought pulling the knot hard might loosen it even more, so I brought it as it was.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the pouch remains attached and you brought it without pulling the cord. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ひもを整えられます。こちらの台へ置いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can straighten out the cord. Could you place it on this counter?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。中身を開けてほしいのではなく、外のひもの緩んだところだけ直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 中身を開けず外ひものみ修正を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I don't want the contents opened; I only want to fix the loose part of the outside cord.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to fix only the outside cord without opening the contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 外側のひもを整えました。持ち上げて、袋が下がった状態を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've adjusted the outside cord. Please lift it and check how it hangs with the pouch suspended.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今は外れずに持てます。帰るまで鞄へ付け直さず、小さい袋へ入れて持って行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 修正後の保持を確認し帰路は袋へ収めたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can hold it now without it coming off. I won't attach it to my bag again before getting home; I'd like to carry it in a small bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check that it can be held after the repair and ask to put it in a bag for the journey home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの持ち帰り用の袋をお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please use this bag to take it home.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。この袋へ入れます。家で鞄の付ける場所を変えて、ひもを何度も引かないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袋へ入れ自宅で取付位置を変えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll put it in this bag. At home, I'll change where I attach it on my bag so I don't keep pulling the cord.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will put it in a bag and change the attachment location at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、大切にお持ち帰りください。ご相談ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take it home with care. Thank you for asking us. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察後の説明の紙は、お手元にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have the written explanation from after your consultation with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ありますが、いただいた二枚が裏返しになって混ざりました。帰宅後に読む順番を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 混ざった説明二枚の読む順を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, but the two sheets I received got mixed up and turned over. Please tell me the order to read them after I get home.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which order to read the two mixed-up explanation sheets. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらが一枚目、こちらが続きです。見出しのある面を上にしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is the first sheet, and this is the continuation. Let's put the side with the heading face up.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。一枚目を上にして重ねます。途中にある図も、この向きで見ればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一枚目を上に重ね図の向きを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I'll stack them with the first sheet on top. Should I look at the diagram partway through in this orientation too?
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Stack the first sheet on top and check the diagram's orientation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、この向きです。説明を聞いて、まだ分からないところはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, this way round. After hearing the explanation, is there anything you still don't understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 図の横に丸を付けたところです。家で家族に見せる前に、何についての欄かもう一度聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 丸印の欄を再説明してほしいと依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The section I circled beside the diagram. Before showing it to my family at home, I'd like to ask again what that section is about.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the circled section to be explained again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その欄について、担当の看護師から説明します。紙を広げたままお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: The nurse in charge will explain that section. Please wait with the sheets spread out.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。聞きたい所に自分で短いメモを付け、紙の文字には重ならないように書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 質問メモを本文と重ならず付けると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I'll add a short note of my question beside the part I want to ask about, without writing over the printed words.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will add question notes without covering the main text. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 説明が終わったら、二枚ともお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: After the explanation, please take both sheets home.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。説明を聞いてから二枚を同じ向きでしまいます。帰宅後は一枚目から家族と読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明後に二枚をそろえて持ち帰り家族と読むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. After listening, I'll put both sheets away facing the same way. At home, I'll read them with my family starting with the first sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will align both sheets after the explanation, take them home, and read them with your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へお声がけします。それでは、紙をお持ちになってこちらでお待ちください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll call the staff member. Please keep the sheets with you and wait here. Take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 先ほどお届けいただいた品物についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the item you brought in earlier?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。連絡先の電話番号に、古い番号を書いてしまいました。帰る前に直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 落とし物届出の古い電話番号を訂正したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I wrote my old phone number as the contact number. I'd like to correct it before leaving.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to correct the old phone number on the found-property report. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受付の控えを拝見します。お名前を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me see your receipt. Please tell me your name.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: グエンです。この控えです。届けたのは駅前で拾った鍵の束です。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 氏名控えと鍵の届出を特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Nguyen. Here is the receipt. The item I handed in was a bunch of keys I found in front of the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give your name and receipt and identify the report concerning the keys. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認できました。現在使える番号を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I've confirmed it. Could you tell me the number you can currently be reached on?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらの携帯の番号です。最後の四桁だけでなく、全部を紙に書いてお見せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現番号を全桁書いて示すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's this mobile number. I'll write the whole number on paper to show you, not just the last four digits.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will write and show every digit of your current number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その番号で記録を確認します。連絡できる時間にもご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check the record using that number. Do you have any preferences about when we can contact you?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 日中は仕事で出られないことがあります。留守番電話に名前と折り返し先を残していただけると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不在時の留守電に名前折返先を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sometimes I can't answer during the day because of work. It would help if you left your name and callback number on voicemail.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for a name and callback number to be left on voicemail if you cannot answer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望を記録します。控えの連絡先もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll record your preference. Please check the contact details on your receipt too.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 新しい番号になりました。今後この件を問い合わせるときは、この受付の控えを手元に置いて電話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新番号と控えを確認し問い合わせ時に使うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: It's the new number now. When I call to ask about this matter in future, I'll keep this receipt to hand.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the new number and receipt, and say that you will use the receipt for future inquiries. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 訂正を確認いただきありがとうございました。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking the correction. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 洗濯用品をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for laundry supplies?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 靴下が洗濯機の中でばらばらになるので、小さい洗濯ネットを買いたいです。どの棚にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 靴下用小型洗濯ネットの棚を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My socks get scattered in the washing machine, so I'd like a small mesh laundry bag. Which shelf are they on?
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which shelf has small mesh laundry bags for socks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの棚に、大きさの違う物がございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this shelf, we have several different sizes.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この小さい物なら、靴下を数組入れられそうです。口はひもでなくファスナーの物を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小型ファスナー式を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: This small one looks as if it will fit a few pairs of socks. I'd prefer one with a zipper rather than a drawstring opening.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for a small zippered version. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらはファスナーで閉める形です。何枚ご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: This one closes with a zipper. How many would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分用と友人用で二枚です。同じ大きさで、色が違う物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二枚同サイズ別色を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Two: one for me and one for a friend. Do you have the same size in different colors?
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for two of the same size in different colors. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 白と青をご用意できます。

DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では一枚ずつお願いします。友人には青を渡し、白は自分で使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 白本人青友人を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then one of each, please. I'll give my friend the blue one and use the white one myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you choose white for yourself and blue for your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 洗濯ばさみも、同じ売り場にございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We also have clothespins in the same section.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: それも探していました。大きい物を二つ選び、ネット二枚と一緒に会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 大洗濯ばさみ二つも一緒に会計すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I was looking for those too. I'll choose two large ones and pay for them together with the two laundry bags.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will pay for two large clothespins together with the bags. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お選びいただきありがとうございます。それでは、こちらをレジへお持ちください。よい一日を。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for choosing these. Please take them to the register. Have a good day.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今夜のおかずをお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for something for tonight's meal?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。二人で焼き魚を食べたいですが、この大きい魚はうちの鍋に入りません。小さい物を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 鍋に入る小魚を二人夕食用に求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The two of us would like grilled fish, but this large one won't fit in our pan. Please show me smaller fish.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for small fish that will fit your pan for two people's dinner. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの小さい魚でしたら、二匹ご用意できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can provide two of these smaller fish.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一人一匹ずつにしたいです。焼くときに困らないよう、下ごしらえをお願いできるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一人一匹で下ごしらえ可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like one fish per person. Could I ask whether you can prepare them so I won't have difficulty cooking them?
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for one fish per person and whether preparation is available. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この売り場では、下ごしらえをしてお渡しできます。どのように使われますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this section, we can prepare them before handing them over. How will you use them?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: フライパンで焼きます。頭と内臓を取った形でお願いします。二匹とも同じようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: フライパン用に頭内臓除去を二匹とも依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll cook them in a frying pan. Please remove the heads and guts, and do both fish the same way.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the heads and guts to be removed from both fish for frying-pan cooking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご用意します。お持ち帰りの袋はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll prepare them. Do you have a bag to take them home in?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 保冷袋を持っています。家まで歩いて帰るので、水が漏れないよう包んでもらえると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 徒歩持帰りの保冷袋と漏れない包装を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have an insulated bag. I'll be walking home, so it would help if you could wrap them so no water leaks out.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Mention your insulated bag and walking journey home, and request leakproof wrapping. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 袋を閉じてお渡しします。二匹でよろしいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll close the bag before handing it over. Two fish, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、二匹です。下ごしらえができたら受け取り、保冷袋へ入れて帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二匹を確認し受取後保冷袋で運ぶと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, two. I'll collect them after they're prepared, put them in my insulated bag, and take them home.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm two fish and say that you will carry them in an insulated bag after collection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お待たせしました。こちらの二匹をお持ちください。おいしく召し上がってくださいね。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for waiting. Here are your two fish. Enjoy your meal, and thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その冊子は、ご家族にもお持ちになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you take that booklet for your family too?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。二部いただきましたが、家族は日本語がまだ読みづらいので、同じページを開いて話したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族と同ページを見るため冊子二部を使いたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I've received two copies, but my family still finds Japanese difficult to read, so I'd like to open the same page and discuss it together.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to use two booklets to look at the same page with your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご覧になりたい見出しは何でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which heading would you like to look at?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 地域の相談についてのページです。私は電話、家族は直接行く相談を考えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人電話家族対面の地域相談ページを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The page about local consultation services. I'm considering a phone consultation, and my family is thinking of going in person.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for the local consultation page, explaining that you want phone service and your family wants an in-person consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その見出しはこちらです。二部とも同じページ番号をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here is that heading. Please check that both copies have the same page number.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見つかりました。家族の冊子には付箋を付け、自分の方には電話の問い合わせ先をメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族冊子へ付箋自分冊子へ電話先を記すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've found it. I'll put a sticky note in my family's booklet and write the telephone inquiry contact in my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will mark your family's copy with a sticky note and write the phone contact in your own. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相談する内容は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you decided what you want to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 住まいについてです。詳しい事情は家族とまとめてから話したいので、今日は相談先の案内を持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 住まい相談事情を家族とまとめ案内のみ持帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Housing. I'd like to discuss the details after organizing them with my family, so today I'll just take home information on where to consult.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Organize the housing circumstances with your family and take home only the consultation information for now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 相談前に、問い合わせ先へご連絡ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please contact the inquiry point before your consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。家で同じページを一緒に読み、電話する人と持参する資料を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同ページを読み連絡役と資料を家で決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. At home, we'll read the same page together and decide who will call and which documents to bring.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will read the same page at home and decide the contact person and documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらの二部をお持ちください。ご家族とのご相談にお役立てください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take these two copies. I hope they help your discussion with your family. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 職業の欄は、もうご記入になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you filled in the occupation field yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだです。昼は会社で働き、週末は小さな店で販売の仕事をしています。二つ書けるか尋ねたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昼の会社と週末店の二仕事を職業欄へ書けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not yet. I work at a company during the day and do sales work in a small shop on weekends. I'd like to ask whether I can write both jobs.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can write your daytime company job and weekend shop job in the occupation field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この相談用の用紙には、現在のお仕事をお書きください。欄が足りなければ、横の余白も使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this consultation form, please write your current work. If the field is too small, you can also use the margin beside it.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、会社の仕事を先に書きます。店の仕事は同じ行へ詰めず、余白へ短く書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社を欄内店を余白へ書くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I'll write the company job first. I won't squeeze the shop job onto the same line; I'll write it briefly in the margin.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will write the company job in the field and the shop job in the margin. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 店では、どのようなお仕事をされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: What kind of work do you do at the shop?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 商品の販売と仕入れです。まだ詳しい説明を日本語でまとめられないので、今日相談したいことも一文添えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 販売仕入れ業務と相談内容を一文添えたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: Selling products and purchasing stock. I can't yet organize a detailed explanation in Japanese, so I'd also like to add one sentence about what I want to discuss today.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe selling and purchasing stock and ask to add one sentence about your consultation topic. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相談したいことを、その下にお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please write what you want to discuss underneath.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二つの仕事について、相談に必要な資料を知りたいと書きます。仕事内容は口頭でも説明できるよう用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二仕事の必要資料を知りたいと記し口頭説明を用意する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll write that I want to know which documents are needed for a consultation about both jobs. I'll also prepare to explain the work verbally.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Write that you want to know the documents needed for the two jobs, and prepare a verbal explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 書けましたら、受付へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you've written it, please show reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 書けました。会社の仕事と週末の販売を書いたので、両方について相談する受付をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記入済の二仕事について受付を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've finished. I wrote the company job and weekend sales work, so please register me for a consultation about both.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for registration to discuss both jobs you have entered. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらの用紙を担当へお渡しします。仕事内容もお聞かせください。本日はありがとうございます。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll give this form to the staff member in charge. Please also tell them about your work. Thank you for coming today. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのラーメンは、ねぎを上にのせてお出しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: This ramen is served with green onions on top.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ねぎは好きですが、最初は入れずに食べたいです。別の小皿で添えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ねぎを丼に入れず別皿で添えるよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: I like green onions, but I'd like to start eating without them. Could you serve them alongside on a separate small plate?
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for the green onions on a separate plate rather than in the bowl. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 別皿でお出しできます。ほかの具は通常どおりでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can serve them separately. Shall we leave the other toppings as usual?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。肉と海苔はそのままお願いします。ねぎだけ別皿にしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 肉海苔を通常のままねぎだけ別と指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Please leave the meat and nori as they are. Only the green onions should be on a separate plate.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify that the meat and nori remain as usual and only the green onions are separate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ねぎの量は、通常の量でよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: Would you like the usual quantity of green onions?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 通常で大丈夫です。半分を最初に加えて、残りは途中で加えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ねぎ通常量で段階的に加えたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: The usual amount is fine. I'd like to add half at the beginning and the rest partway through.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you want the usual amount of green onions and will add them in stages. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 卓上の薬味も、お好みでお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can also use the condiments on the table as you like.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 辛い物は今日は使いません。まずそのまま食べて、ねぎを少しずつ加えるだけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 辛味不要でそのまま食べねぎのみ追加と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't use anything spicy today. I'll eat it as it comes first, then only add green onions a little at a time.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you do not want spicy seasoning, will eat it as it comes, and will add only green onions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それでは、こちらがラーメンと別皿のねぎです。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here are your ramen and the green onions on a separate plate.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 希望どおりです。丼には肉と海苔があり、ねぎは別皿ですね。途中で自分で加えながらいただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 提供内容を照合し自分でねぎを加えて食べると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: That's just as I requested. The meat and nori are in the bowl, and the green onions are separate. I'll add them myself as I eat.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the food served and say that you will add the green onions yourself while eating. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご注文を確認いただきありがとうございます。それでは、温かいうちにお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking your order. Please enjoy it while it's hot.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: おでんの追加はいかがでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to order more oden?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 注文したいですが、この大根が大きくて二人で分けたいです。先に取り皿を二枚いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大根分け用の取り皿二枚を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to, but this daikon is large and we want to share it. Could we have two side plates first?
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for two side plates to share the daikon. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 取り皿をお持ちします。お箸ももう一組必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll bring the plates. Do you need another pair of chopsticks too?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。友人が自分の箸を落としてしまったので、新しい箸を一組ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 落とした友人の箸交換を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, please. My friend dropped their chopsticks, so please give us one new pair.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to replace your friend's dropped chopsticks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらをどうぞ。追加の具はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here you are. Have you decided which additional ingredients to order?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 大根を分けてから決めます。今は卵を一つだけ追加して、二人で味を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 大根後に追加を決め卵一つのみ希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: We'll decide after sharing the daikon. For now, we'd like just one extra egg so the two of us can taste it.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will decide on more after the daikon and ask for only one egg now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 卵を一つですね。飲み物の追加もございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: One egg, then. Would you like more drinks too?

DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私は温かいお茶をお願いします。友人は今の飲み物が残っているので、追加しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分お茶友人飲物追加不要を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like hot tea. My friend still has some of their current drink, so they don't want another.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for tea for yourself and explain that your friend does not need another drink. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お茶と卵をお持ちします。落とした箸はこちらでお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll bring the tea and egg. We'll take the dropped chopsticks here.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。落とした箸をお渡しします。大根は取り皿へ分け、追加は卵一つでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 落とした箸を渡し具と皿の数を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll hand you the dropped chopsticks. We'll divide the daikon onto the side plates, and please add just one egg.
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over the dropped chopsticks and confirm the number of ingredients and plates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、ご注文を承りました。温かいうちに、ゆっくりお召し上がりください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-022-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, your order is noted. Enjoy your food slowly while it's warm. Thank you.
